principles: Prefer small, focused modules with clear boundaries.
Keep behavior covered by tests and measurable with maid metrics and gates.

bestPractices.commits: Make small, atomic commits. Use an imperative subject line (72 characters or fewer) and explain why in the body. Run tests and `maid gate` before committing. Capture a pending snapshot before a commit and finalize after.
bestPractices.formatting: Run `maid format` and `maid check`; Biome is the source of truth for formatting.
bestPractices.testing: Keep the full test suite passing and add or update tests for behavior changes.
bestPractices.documentation: Update README or docs for user-visible or workflow changes.
